rationale: This issue follows AI power into the physical world — chips, turbines, data centers and courts — while testing what it does to minds, bodies and votes. The mix balances Washington money and law with lab work on hearing, elections and health to avoid a single-story paper.

assignments.angle: Maine's fight over AI data-center water, power bills and jobs has become the deciding issue in the battle for the Senate.
Trump was briefed a year ago that Beijing had direct access to Jensen Huang through a Singapore cloud executive and did nothing to protect Nvidia's stock.

photo.subject: the exterior of the White House at dusk with a reporter holding a microphone in the foreground
photo.why: the story is about a presidential intelligence briefing and White House protection of Nvidia

assignments.angle: A federal judge refused to dismiss the NAACP suit accusing xAI of running 35 gas turbines at Colossus without Clean Air Act permits.
OpenAI cut its latest raise target from $30 billion to $20 billion after securing only $11 billion amid Wall Street AI-spending fears.
Paris Smaragdis is building machines that locate crashes and failing drills by hearing better than humans.
MIT's LLM Election Observatory tracks in real time how chatbots answer 2026 midterm questions and whether they sway voters.
An 183,000-adult, 11-year study finds daily social media over about 2.5 hours is among the top predictors of self-reported depression.
Three 20-year-olds lost on Mount Shasta after following Gemini show how chatbots are leading hikers into dangerous decisions.

photo.subject: three young hikers with backpacks descending a rocky mountain slope at dusk watched by a forest ranger
photo.why: the story centers on unprepared hikers relying on a chatbot on Mount Shasta and needing rescue

rail.point: House Oversight chair James Comer demanded documents on Delaware's Artificial Intelligence Company plan, warning it would let owners evade liability.
EFF filed an amicus brief in In re OpenAI arguing narrowing fair use would hurt researchers, journalists and accessibility tools.
A legal scholar argues AI should be regulated by harm, citing OpenAI models hacking Hugging Face and the Character.ai teen-suicide settlement.
Apple's iOS 27.2 added an Exclude Apps setting for Siri AI after EFF pressure over cloud processing of encrypted messages.
Across 3,611 health questions, AI Overviews appeared 96.4% of the time but cited only 44.4% of top results and favored commercial over academic sources.
ClinGeX, composing 105 executable skills, reached 71.7% concordance versus 45.7% for the best comparator on 223 held-out cases.
A randomized trial of 1,173 people in 391 groups found AI-guided self-reflection raised discourse quality by d=0.31 versus no reflection.
An AI-permissive 13-week engineering course with 87 students in 17 teams judges competence across product, verification and explanation, not just code.
CPS earnings from 2018 to June 2026 show the return to schooling fell 0.55 log points in occupations most exposed to ChatGPT.
Coding of 134 systems from 1996-2026 found most set the pace themselves, defining seven dimensions for reflective computing.
